prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 511px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 510px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对比四款产品的价格、屏幕、续航、重量和评价，帮助读者选购。","reading":"读者先按型号定位产品，再纵向比较价格和规格，最后阅读评价；每一行应保持清晰，便于把各项信息归属于同一款产品。","groups":["型号用于识别产品，价格是选购时的直接比较项。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可横向比较的规格，应保持紧凑且易于逐列扫描。","评价是描述性文字，承担补充说明的作用，需要比规格列更多的弹性空间。"],"keep_intact":["价格及其货币符号","型号中的字母和数字标识","屏幕尺寸、重量数值及其单位","续航数值及其单位"],"may_wrap":["评价可在自然语义处换行，并可利用规格列换行形成的行高。","屏幕描述可在尺寸和面板类型之间换行。","空间紧张时，型号可在品牌与产品标识之间换行，续航可在约数与时长之间换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [85, 71, 75, 60, 60, 159] · table 511×392px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [85, 71, 75, 70, 60, 149] · table 511×392px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [100, 71, 75, 60, 60, 144] · table 511×392px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"价格和重量保持完整，评价列在三版中最宽；各行边界清楚，便于将规格和评价归属于同一型号。","problems":"多款产品的屏幕尺寸被拆成“6.7 英 / 寸”，续航也频繁断行；“星河 X1 Pro”分两行，识别时略显零碎。","cause":"屏幕列 75px 扣除内边距和边框后仅有 54px，容不下完整尺寸；续航列 60px 较窄，型号列 85px 容不下最长型号。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"续航列更宽，较短的“约 1 天”和“约 2 天”能保持一行，便于纵向比较；价格和重量仍完整。","problems":"屏幕尺寸仍被拆开，较长续航仍需换行；评价列变窄后文字更密，最长型号也仍分行。整体高度没有减少。","cause":"续航列从 60px 增至 70px，但屏幕列仍为 75px；新增宽度取自评价列，使其降至 149px。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"四个型号都能保持一行，产品识别最清楚；价格和重量完整，行与行之间的分隔也清晰。","problems":"屏幕尺寸仍被拆开，续航频繁换行；评价列是三版中最窄的，文字显得更密，而整表高度并未降低。","cause":"型号列增至 100px，占用了评价列的空间；屏幕列仍为 75px，续航列仍为 60px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"screen-first","widths":[85,71,81,60,60,153],"change":"以 r2A 为基础，将屏幕列加宽 6px，尝试让尺寸和单位保持完整，并在面板类型前换行；评价列仍保留 153px。"},{"name":"screen-battery","widths":[85,71,81,70,60,143],"change":"在加宽屏幕列的同时保留 r2B 的 70px 续航列，比较规格扫描更顺畅与评价文字更密之间的取舍。"},{"name":"model-screen","widths":[100,71,81,60,60,138],"change":"保留 r2C 单行型号的优势，同时加宽屏幕列；用于检验型号和尺寸完整所需的空间是否值得评价列进一步收窄。"}]}
